mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_orders(refund_no, order_id, order_no, user_id, product_id, reason, description, refund_amount, status, create_time) VALUES(#{refundNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{reason}, #{description}, #{refundAmount}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM refund_orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_orders SET status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, admin_reply = #{adminReply}, audit_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
